issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, в нашем деле гланое - этот самый реализм!
issues.translation_quote: As our dear boss says, in our line of work, realism's the thing!
issues.justification: The boss's catchphrases ("как говорит наш дорогой шеф") are comic parodies of proverbs. Several are rendered literally or flattened, e.g. 'if a man's an idiot, it's a lifelong condition', and 'strike while the iron's hot, right at the cash register', which loses the pun on the original idiom. The humor is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I ain't goin' along with that!
issues.justification: The speaker's mock-hick dialect works as a comic disguise as the 'taxi driver'. Here it is overdone with 'ain't', and elsewhere ('Jus' like we agreed', 'I didn't do nothin'') the dialect marking is inconsistent and drifts into a US/English-regional register that does not match the Soviet setting.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! I hope I see you in your coffin, wearing white slippers! May you live... on nothing but... your salary!
issues.justification: The curse is an Odessa-style comic rant with deliberately non-standard grammar ('у гробу, у белых тапках'). The translation is standard English and loses the dialectal comedic voice, and the final curse is clumsily broken up.
The transliteration changes between 'zigel', 'tsigel' variants and is inconsistent with the Russian-based transcription used elsewhere in the pseudo-foreign passages.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets and you just might win a... Waterworks!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) is lost, so the comic sloganeering effect disappears.
